title: Finite-Sample Honest Intervals for a Causal Boundary Estimand under Laplace Noise
banked_reason: kernel_substituted@thm:critical-length: promised sharp full-class curve, compact-uniform convergence, certified full-game brackets, and original-data decision equivalence are not derived; independent main validity gate confirms terminal substitution.
gap_reasons: The promised sharp full-class curve V_beta(kappa), compact-uniform convergence, certified full-game brackets, and original-data decision equivalence are expressly not derived; this theorem instead gives critical-order envelopes, finite-n near-attainment of L_n, and subsequential cluster curves.
proof_attempt_summary: Three D0 solve rounds attempted sharp localization and original-data decision transfer. The direct taper and finite-energy exhaustion routes failed to establish the full-class game equality, so the result was reduced candidly to order bounds, finite-n near-attainment, and cluster curves. Math and all eleven citations passed informal review, but the original sharp kernel remains undelivered; no Lean formalization or impossibility proof was produced.
tldr: The note provides computable original-record intervals with exact \(90\)-percent finite-sample honesty and excess worst expected length at most \(8h_n^\beta/n^2\) over the unrestricted connected-interval minimax value. Uniform critical-order lower and upper bounds and exact Laplace noise monotonicity hold under the unchanged latent-side model. Nested legal compact likelihood experiments give positive certified lower envelopes. A count-retaining hybrid Gaussian comparison transfers bounded-local connected-interval games with error \(o(1)\) on target ranges \(A_n=o(n^{1/6})\). Rescaled minimax curves have positive finite monotone subsequential cluster curves attained by the original-data family. A unique sharp constant curve and full continuation-game equivalence are not established.
gap: Vanishing-noise orders, fixed-noise endpoint inversion, affine Gaussian interval optimization and general confidence-set duality are occupied. They leave the complete critical true-side likelihood, its unrestricted connected-interval value, and sharp original-record decision transfer unresolved.
fill: The common sharp value is derived through complete marked likelihoods and a localization equality, evaluated by finite certified connected-action games, and attained by exactly honest original-data decisions.
